extracted.stage: Financial provision action proceeding to proof
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the pursuer in a financial provision action at Edinburgh Sheriff Court asks whether funding of around £48,000 is available, with matrimonial property of around £480,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the clear summary of the matter. So that we can consider it properly, we would be grateful for confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the proceedings are raised, details of the matrimonial property and any existing security or charges over it, the anticipated costs budget through to proof, and any key hearing or procedural dates. Please also confirm your client's details and your firm's contact for correspondence. We will review the information once received and come back to you; nothing in this message should be taken as an offer or an indication of terms.
